description.en: Sets up a technique cutscene participant using an actual match roster member's appearance (by param ID), instead of the raw face/body/equipment IDs used by SetChrPrmDetailForSkillScript.
Slot index on that side (for multi-character techniques).
Match roster member's param ID to pull appearance from.
Optional team slot to look the member up in (defaults to 2).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Set up the attacking character for a technique cutscene using a match roster member's appearance
SetChrPrmDetailForSkillScriptAtMatch("ATK", 1, "para_cp0009");
